title: 날짜형 함수 - SYADATE, EXTRACT, TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(date_expr)), 날짜 연산
markdown: > > > > > 목차 > > - [현재 날짜: SYSDATE, GETDATE()](#246eda9b0fe1806495a7c128590747c0) > - [현재 날짜 필터링 1: extract('포맷' FROM SYSDATE), DATEPART(포맷, GETDATE()), 포맷(GETDATE())](#246eda9b0fe18096a8aecc15d8bfd3c2) > - [현재 날짜 필터링 2: extract('포맷' FROM SYSDATE), DATEPART(포맷, GETDATE()), 포맷(GETDATE())](#246eda9b0fe180e88e72e7f9c1d82e00) > - [날짜 연산: TO_DATE(), convert(), dateadd()](#246eda9b0fe180dab7deef1fad82bcf5) ### 현재 날짜: SYSDATE, GETDATE() ```sql # Oracle SELECT SYSDATE # 결과: 2025-08-05 11:16:58.000 ( 현재 시간 ) FROM dual ``` ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/fc1a496aabc930cad33c0d4b5cf3aa52c36a6efc/posts/246eda9b-0fe1-80f2-a905-e36795a2ffee/ba954e2459dbaed7.webp) ```sql # SQL Server SELECT GETDATE() # 결과: 현재 시간 ``` ### 현재 날짜 필터링 1: extract('포맷' FROM SYSDATE), DATEPART(포맷, GETDATE()), 포맷(GETDATE()) ```sql # Oracle SELECT SYSDATE, extract(DAY FROM SYSDATE), extract(MONTH FROM SYSDATE), extract(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) FROM dual ``` ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/fc1a496aabc930cad33c0d4b5cf3aa52c36a6efc/posts/246eda9b-0fe1-80f2-a905-e36795a2ffee/a34700eae72526a3.webp) ```sql # SQL Server SELECT # DATEPART(포맷, GETDATE()) DATEPART(DAY, GETDATE()), DATEPART(MONTH, GETDATE()), DATEPART(YEAR, GETDATE()), # 포맷(GETDATE()) DAY(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), YEAR(GETDATE()), GETDATE() ``` ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/fc1a496aabc930cad33c0d4b5cf3aa52c36a6efc/posts/246eda9b-0fe1-80f2-a905-e36795a2ffee/b100b7530885b033.webp) ### 현재 날짜 필터링 2: extract('포맷' FROM SYSDATE), DATEPART(포맷, GETDATE()), 포맷(GETDATE()) ```sql SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY')) FROM dual ``` ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/fc1a496aabc930cad33c0d4b5cf3aa52c36a6efc/posts/246eda9b-0fe1-80f2-a905-e36795a2ffee/4197893bcd89374c.webp) ```sql # SQL Server SELECT # DATEPART(포맷, GETDATE()) DATEPART(DAY, GETDATE()), DATEPART(MONTH, GETDATE()), DATEPART(YEAR, GETDATE()), # 포맷(GETDATE()) DAY(GETDATE()), MONTH(GETDATE()), YEAR(GETDATE()), GETDATE() ``` ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/fc1a496aabc930cad33c0d4b5cf3aa52c36a6efc/posts/246eda9b-0fe1-80f2-a905-e36795a2ffee/b100b7530885b033.webp) ### 날짜 연산: TO_DATE(), convert(), dateadd() ```sql SELECT TO_DATE('2025-08-05', 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE('2025-08-05', 'YYYY-MM-DD')+1, # + 날짜 TO_DATE('2025-08-05', 'YYYY-MM-DD')+1/24, # + 시간 TO_DATE('2025-08-05', 'YYYY-MM-DD')+1/24/60 # + 분 FROM dual ``` ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/fc1a496aabc930cad33c0d4b5cf3aa52c36a6efc/posts/246eda9b-0fe1-80f2-a905-e36795a2ffee/4197893bcd89374c.webp) ```sql # SQL Server SELECT # convert(DATETIME, 날짜) convert(DATETIME, '2025-08-05'), convert(DATETIME, '2025-08-05')+1, # + 날짜 convert(DATETIME, '2025-08-05')+1/24, # + 시간 convert(DATETIME, '2025-08-05')+1/24/60, # + 분 # dateadd() dateadd(hour, 3, convert(DATETIME, '2025-08-05')) ``` ![+ 1시간: 1/24](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/fc1a496aabc930cad33c0d4b5cf3aa52c36a6efc/posts/246eda9b-0fe1-80f2-a905-e36795a2ffee/8ef2e61217c70f7a.webp) ![+ 1분: 1/24/60](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/fc1a496aabc930cad33c0d4b5cf3aa52c36a6efc/posts/246eda9b-0fe1-80f2-a905-e36795a2ffee/66cd932cb8b728a2.webp) ![+ 4분: 1/24/15](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/fc1a496aabc930cad33c0d4b5cf3aa52c36a6efc/posts/246eda9b-0fe1-80f2-a905-e36795a2ffee/f1abbe2300ac1b36.webp) ![+ 1초: 1/24/60/60](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/fc1a496aabc930cad33c0d4b5cf3aa52c36a6efc/posts/246eda9b-0fe1-80f2-a905-e36795a2ffee/9a5e985987c30e18.webp)
